selection.method: Shortlist contains three text-cued rows from the raw listed site-harvest lane. Cues flag records for manual source review; they do not classify drinks or correct category values.

limitations: Rows are source-ledger records, not independent confirmation that a venue still sells an item or that the captured price is currently purchasable.
No corrected category, price, serving size, or availability is inferred.
The soda, tonic, ginger ale, and named-item cues are candidates for manual source reproduction only.
